- [USER] User has never heard of Tubbataha Reef before.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tubbataha Reef is located in the middle of the Sulu Sea, around 150 kilometers southeast of Puerto Princesa City in Palawan.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tubbataha Reef is only accessible by boat, and visitors need to join a liveaboard diving cruise to reach the reef.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Liveaboard boats usually depart from Puerto Princesa or the nearby municipality of Dumaran.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Tubbataha Management Office regulates the number of visitors to the area to protect its delicate ecosystem.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is recommended to plan and book ahead of time for Tubbataha Reef.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The best time to visit Tubbataha Reef is from March to June, when the seas are calmer and visibility is better for diving and snorkeling.
